versions.content: The LIN Interface shall provide the N_Cs timeout observation (configuration parameter LinTpNcs) in order to switch a schedule table from diagnostic schedule to applicative schedule in case the transmission for MRF is not successful. (The ISO 17987 specifications define the following requirement: (N_Cs+N_As) < 0.9*N_Cr timeout)
